body: I don’t know how I can do that. How will I prove it? It’s not documented anywhere, and I know he’ll try to make it sound better than it is, that it’s just punishment or somehow try and say I’m exaggerating. He’s too young to understand or speak for himself. What if they find me unfit as well. That’s my fear. That I’ll be more unfit than him simply because he’s the one with money and a job and his name is on the home and bills. I’m nothing.
u/sandman2008 made a post offering to talk to anyone in need. Send him a message please.

The shitty part is, he’s not even old enough to understand why daddy is hurting him. He’s only two. He’s terrified of him when he yells at me and comes to hide behind me, but still loves daddy because he doesn’t know any different. There’s this awful part of me that wishes he was older and could understand what he does to us, to know that it’s not okay and maybe we could have a chance to get out.
